"# Implementation Plan: Detailed Receipts & Black Theme Styling

We will enhance the Receipts view in the POS frontend application by expanding the details displayed for each bill, ensuring all text inside the receipt details panel is strictly black, and changing the action and pagination buttons on the Receipts tab to black.

## Proposed Changes

### POS Frontend App

#### [MODIFY] [App.jsx](file:///c:/Users/Sajad/Desktop/SaSLoop/pos-app/src/App.jsx)

1. **Exhaustive Bill Details in Left Column**:
   - Update the active receipt rendering inside the vertical scrollable container.
   - Include the following additional fields:
     - Store metadata (Business Name, Address, Phone)
     - Order ID (unique database reference)
     - Cashier/User (who generated the transaction)
     - Covers Count (if present)
     - Order Status
     - Payment Status
     - Bill Notes/Instructions (KOT note/custom instruction)
     - Total Items count and total quantity sum
     - Amount in words (using `numberToWords` helper)
     - Paid amount and change returned

2. **Black Color Styling for Receipt Details Panel**:
   - Ensure every label, value, and nested tag inside the scrollable receipt details container has `text-black` color.
   - Strip all `text-slate-500`, `text-slate-600`, `text-amber-*`, and inline colors (`#64748b`, `#475569`, etc.), replacing them with `#000000` or `text-black`.

3. **Black Color Styling for Tab Action Buttons**:
   - Locate and modify the buttons in the Top Action Bar:
     - **All Bills** (selected: `bg-black border-black text-white hover:bg-neutral-800`, unselected: `bg-[#21262d] text-[#c9d1d9] border-[#30363d] hover:bg-[#30363d]`)
